summaries.zh: Steam Workshop-style plugin browser for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI - zero-server: GitHub-powered search, trending windows, Chinese search & bilingual translation, plugin-signature filtering, and smart one-click install/update/uninstall with an installed-plugins manager.
summaries.en: Steam Workshop-style plugin browser for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) Web UI - zero-server: GitHub-powered search, trending windows, Chinese search & bilingual translation, plugin-signature filtering, and smart one-click install/update/uninstall with an installed-plugins manager.
